title: [Main] Expense Management: add partner extension events and make Create Expense Report public
summary: Expense management adds integration events for partners to customize expense report lines and posting without friend access, and makes the Create Expense Report codeunit public with a focused API surface.
key_points: Seven new integration events cover copying expense fields to report lines, posting operations, per diem calculations, and post-posting follow-up actions
Create Expense Report codeunit changed from internal to public, exposing only the AddSingleExpenseToExpenseReport procedure while keeping UI methods internal
Integration events added to Expense Report-Post, Expense Ledger Entry, and Expense Per Diem Calculation objects to support localization and partner customizations
Existing events like OnAfterReleaseExpense and OnCheckExpenseReportPostRestrictions are reused for consistency
Per diem calculation refactored to delegate to a local procedure for event raising without changing behavior for non-subscribers
quote: adds a minimal set of integration events, each tied to a scenario, so partners can customize expense report lines and posting
